note: Trigger evals in the format agentskills.io documents: realistic requests, labelled with whether this skill should be consulted. They test ROUTING, which the assertion evals in evals.json cannot: those are graded by matching the answer text, so they only ever measure what the skill does once it is already loaded. Prompts are written in the vocabulary maintainers and editors use, deliberately not in the skill's own. Two rules they must keep. No prompt is copied from a benchmark that measures this skill, and no case identifier or measured figure appears here: a skill that ships a benchmark's own prompts contaminates every run it takes part in, and this file did exactly that until it was rewritten. Sharing a subject with a benchmark case is unavoidable and fine; sharing its sentences is not.

queries.query: Which TYPO3 versions does this extension actually claim to support? I get a different answer depending on where I look.
composer.json says ^12.4 but ext_emconf.php says 11.5-12.4.99. Which one is right?
queries.note: the two artefacts named outright, the shortest form of the same question

queries.query: We support v12 and v13 now. Did I update every place that names a version, or did I miss one?
I bumped the version for the release and somewhere it still shows the old one.
queries.note: a version bump that did not reach every file stating the version

queries.query: Have a look over this extension before I hand it on — what would you flag?
queries.note: the unspecific request; it routed reliably even before the description named any artefact

queries.query: Is this extension ready for the TER, and is it still using anything deprecated in v13?
Tag 2.4.2, write the notes and get everything ready to publish, but do not push.
queries.note: github-release owns this; conformance answering it would be a false positive

queries.query: An editor saves a record in one of our backend modules and it silently keeps the previous content. Find out why.
queries.note: a runtime defect, not a question about what the extension declares

queries.query: The width an editor sets on an image in the RTE is stored but lost again when the page renders.
queries.note: a rendering defect, reported by a user of one extension
